description: This file contains utility functions for computing hourly and daily rollups of telemetry data from devices, including aggregation functions and database interactions.

methods.name: _aggregate(points: List[Dict], metric: str)
methods.description: Aggregates a list of telemetry points for a specific metric, calculating average, min, max, and count.

methods.name: _rollup_for_window(device_id: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, period: str)
methods.description: Performs rollups for a given device within a specified time window, computing aggregates for each metric observed.

methods.name: run_hourly_rollups()
methods.description: Computes hourly rollups for all devices by aggregating telemetry data for the last hour.

methods.name: run_daily_rollups()
methods.description: Computes daily rollups for all devices by aggregating telemetry data for the last day.

ctags.name: _rollup_for_window
ctags.pattern: /^async def _rollup_for_window(device_id: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, period: str):$/
ctags.signature: (device_id: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, period: str)
